ProgressPercent formula uses 100.0 double multiplication to prevent integer truncation before division. [NotifyPropertyChangedFor] on both frame counter fields ensures ProgressPercent raises PropertyChanged on every update.

ProgressPercent is unbounded when FramesDone > FramesTotal (could return > 100). This is not a defect — the progress reporter owns the invariant that FramesDone <= FramesTotal. No guard needed here; adding one would be defensive over-engineering for a ViewModel property.
